title: LibScript DOS (FreeDOS & MIT MS-DOS 1.25/2.0/4.00) Synthesis Execution Plan
description: Declarative configuration schema for synthesizing bootable FreeDOS (1.3, 1.4) and MIT MS-DOS (1.25, 2.0, 4.00) floppies, partitioned FAT16/FAT32 hard disks, El Torito ISOs, QCOW2 images, and Vagrant boxes.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI reference for validation.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the declarative DOS profile format.

profile_name.description: Unique lowercase slug identifying this DOS synthesis profile.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the target DOS kernel, shell, and DPMI runtime.

dos_flavor.description: Primary DOS kernel family (GPL-2.0 FreeDOS or MIT Microsoft MS-DOS).

dos_version.description: Target DOS release version (FreeDOS 1.3/1.4 or MIT MS-DOS 1.25/2.0/4.0).

build_mode.description: Synthesis mode: compile/assemble kernels from source or repack verified release archives.

shell_provider.description: Primary SHELL= command interpreter staged into CONFIG.SYS/FDCONFIG.SYS (stock COMMAND.COM, FreeCOM, 16-bit win-cmd-asm WINCMD.COM/WINCMD1.COM, or 32-bit DJGPP win-cmd-rs WINCMD.EXE).

dpmi_provider.description: 32-bit protected-mode DPMI or linear-executable extender staged for i386+ targets.

djgpp_userland.description: Whether to stage 32-bit DJGPP GNU bash, coreutils, and DJGPP.ENV on dos32-dpmi strata.

lfn_enabled.description: Whether to load DOSLFN.COM and export LFN=y (supported on FreeDOS; forced false on strict 8.3 MS-DOS).

serial_console.description: Serial UART telemetry routing for headless QEMU/Vagrant COM1 automation.

packet_driver.description: Crynwr INT 60h Ethernet packet driver initialized in AUTOEXEC.BAT for Watt-32 and mTCP.

config_sys.description: Declarative CONFIG.SYS / FDCONFIG.SYS tuning parameters (omitted on MS-DOS 1.25).

files.description: Maximum concurrent open file handles configured via FILES=.

buffers.description: Number of sector cache buffers allocated via BUFFERS=.

lastdrive.description: Highest drive letter reserved in the CDS array via LASTDRIVE=.

dos_high_umb.description: Whether to load HIMEMX/HIMEM.SYS and relocate DOS into HMA/UMB when targeting 386+.

target.description: CPU architecture, OS family, and C runtime specification.

arch.description: Target x86 ISA level (i8086 real mode or i386/i586/i686 DPMI protected mode).

libc.description: Target C runtime or freestanding FCB ABI.

platform.description: Target hypervisor or PC hardware platform (e.g. qemu, virtualbox, bare-metal).

kernel.description: DOS kernel source provider and version configuration.

storage.description: Disk or floppy media geometry, partition table, and boot sector specification.

media_type.description: Physical floppy or partitioned hard-disk layout generated by mkdosfs_img.

disk_size_gib.description: Nominal virtual disk capacity in GiB (0 or 1 for floppy/small FAT volumes).

partition_table.description: Partition scheme (mbr for hard disks, none for superfloppy images).

boot_mode.description: Legacy IBM PC BIOS INT 19h / INT 13h boot mode.

mountpoint.description: DOS drive root (e.g. C:\ or A:\).

output_formats.description: Target image formats emitted from this DOS profile.

components.description: List of DOS-compatible LibScript components staged into C:\LIBSCRIP.

items.description: Component name or virtual capability alias.
